Container.Name: owncryptofolio
Container.Overview: Self-hosted crypto portfolio tracker with German tax reports. Reads exchanges (API or export file), 35 blockchain networks and your own files, merges them into one history, values everything with stored prices and shows holdings, profit and loss, the yearly German tax report (Excel/PDF) and a source-of-funds statement. Needs a PostgreSQL container. English and German interface.[br][br]Selbst gehosteter Krypto-Portfolio-Tracker mit deutschem Steuerbericht. Braucht einen PostgreSQL-Container.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: crypto bitcoin portfolio tracker tax steuer finance
Container.Requires: A PostgreSQL container (version 18 or older), e.g. "postgresql18" from Community Applications.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port of the web interface in your network

Config.Name: Data (keys, originals, logs)
Config.Description: Holds the keys - include it in your backups!

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Encrypted backups; better a share that is backed up off the server

Config.Name: Database: host
Config.Description: IP or name of the PostgreSQL server (Unraid IP for a PostgreSQL container on bridge)

Config.Name: Database: name
Config.Description: Created on the first start if missing

Config.Name: Database: user
Config.Description: Needs the right to create a database (CREATEDB)

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the app runs as; 99 = nobody (Unraid default)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the app runs as; 100 = users (Unraid default)

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Time stamps in the log; the interface has its own setting
